met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough aloft in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 78°E to the north of Lat. 28°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over east Telangana & adjoining Coastal Andhra Pradesh at 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over east Bangladesh & neighbourhood now lies over northeast Bangladesh at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough in easterlies from Southeast Arabian Sea adjoining Kerala to South Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
A fresh Western Disturbance likely to affect northwestern Himalayan region from 10th November.
